answerAuthority.relation: Direct child of the input ref; adds _validate_collection_access([collection_name], user, access_type='write') when collection_name is supplied to process_file.
CVE-2026-45398 describes file ownership without destination-collection authorization and lists /process/file as a vulnerable write endpoint.
The fixed source path shows the user-controlled target reaches the write sink without a knowledge-base write check.

maintainerFix.patchSummary: Adds the shared write-access validator after resolving a caller-supplied collection_name in process_file; the same commit also covers process_files_batch.
